questions.question: If a + b = 8 and ab = 12, then the value of a³ + b³ is:
questions.solution:
**Given - **

a + b = 8, ab = 12

**Formula used - **

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a³ + b³) = (a + b) (a² - ab + b²)

**Solution - **

a+ b = 8, ab = 12

⇒ 8² = a² + b² + 2 × 12

⇒ a² + b² = 40

⇒ a³ + b³ = 8 × (40 - 12) = 224

**∴ a³ + b³ = 224.**

**Short trick - **

put a = 6, b = 2 or a = 2, b = 6

⇒ Both satisfy the given expression.

⇒ a³ + b³ = 6³ + 2³ = 216 + 8 = 224

∴ a3 + b3 = 224.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Go by hit and trial method

a + b = 8 and ab = 12

put a = 6 and b = 2

∴ a³ + b³ = 224.

**Given data:**

In ΔABC,

AP ⊥ BC

AQ is the angle bisector of ∠PAC

⇒ ∠PAQ = ∠CAQ

**Concept used:**

Sum of all angles of a triangle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

In ΔAPC,

AP ⊥ BC

∠PCA = 30° (Given)

⇒ 90° + 30° + ∠CAP = 180° 

⇒ ∠CAP = (180° - 90° - 30°)

⇒ ∠CAP = 60° 

Now, ∠CAP = ∠PAQ + ∠CAQ

⇒ 60° = 2∠PAQ [∵ ∠PAQ = ∠CAQ (Given)]

⇒ ∠PAQ = 30°

**∴**** The measure of ****∠****PAQ is 30°.**

questions.question: If cosec θ=(x²+y²)/(x²-y² ), then what will be the value of tan θ?
questions.solution:
**Solution:**

**Given data:**

Cosec θ = (x² + y²)/ (x² - y²)

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c102c71416b4bf7cad997fbee18bca408b7ceccd2861e39bf3d8af9c5dd1555.png] 

In ΔABC,

b² = a² + c²

Sin A = a/b

Cos A = c/b

Tan A = a/c

Cosec A = b/a

Sec A = b/c

Cot A = c/a

**Calculation:**

Cosec θ = (x² + y²)/(x² - y²)

⇒ b = (x² + y²)

⇒ a = (x² - y²)

b² = a² + c²

⇒ (x² + y²)² = (x² - y²)² + c²

⇒ c² = (x⁴ + 2x²y² + y⁴) – (x⁴ – 2x²y² + y⁴)

⇒ c² = 4x²y²

⇒ c = 2xy ----(Taking square root of both the sides)

Tan θ = a/c

⇒ tan θ = (x² - y²)/2xy

 

**∴**** The value of tan θ is (x² - y²)/2xy.**

questions.question: The value of a motorcycle depreciates every year by 4%. What will be its value after 2 years, if its present value is Rs. 75,000?
questions.solution:
**Solution:**

**Given data:**

Present value of motorcycle = Rs. 75,000

Rate of depreciation = 4%

Time for depreciation = 2 years

**Concept used:**

Final value = Initial value × [(100 – Rate of depreciation)/100]ⁿ

Where, n = no. of years

**Calculation:**

Final value = Initial value × [(100 – Rate of depreciation)/100]ⁿ

⇒ 75,000 × [(100 – 4)/100]²

⇒ 75,000 × (96/100)²

⇒ 75,000 × (24/25)²

⇒ (75,000 × 576)/625

⇒ 69,120

**∴**** The value of the motorcycle after 2 years will be Rs. 69,120.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**The above solution can also be understood in easy language:

4% = 4/100 = 1/25

So Remaining 96% = 24/25

Let the final value be y

y = 75,000 × 24/25 × 24/25

y = 69,120

∴ The value of the motorcycle after 2 years will be Rs. 69,120.

questions.question: In a company with 600 employees, the average age of the male employees is 42 years and that of the female employees is 41 years. If the average age of all the employees in the company is 41 years 9 months, then the number of female employees is:
questions.solution:
**Solution:**

**Given data: **

No. of employees in company = 600

The average age of the male employees = 42 years

The average age of the female employees = 41 years

The average age of all the employees in the company = 41 years 9 months

⇒ (41 + 9/12) years

⇒ 167/4 years

**Concept used:**

Average = (Sum of all cases)/(Number of cases)

**Calculation:**

Let no. of male employees be x.

⇒ No. of female employees = 600 – x.

Sum of ages of all male employees = x × 42

⇒ 42x years ----(1)

Sum of ages of all male employees = (600 – x) × 41

⇒ (24600 – 41x) years ----(2)

Sum of ages of all employees = 42x + 24600 – 41x ----(Adding equation 1 and 2)

⇒ (x + 24600) years ----(3)

Sum of ages of all employees = 600 × 167/4

⇒ 25050 years ----(4)

Equating equations 3 and 4

⇒ x + 24600 = 25050

⇒ x = 450

⇒ No. of male employees = 450

⇒ No. of female employees = 600 – 450

⇒ 150

**∴**** The number of female employees in the company is 150.**

 

**Alternate method:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54c8c6a47e1cb7d25f43874e6b9af3f711ee6754a5b3d9b56dab9cf7e15703d.png] 

No. of male employees: No. of female employees = 3 : 1

⇒ No. of male employees = 3x

⇒ No. of female employees = x

⇒ Total no. of employees = 4x

⇒ 4x = 600 ----(given data)

⇒ x = 600/4

⇒ x = 150

⇒ No. of female employees = x = 150

 

**∴ The number of female employees in company is 150.**

questions.question: If the gain is one-fifth of the selling price, then the gain percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The gain is one-fifth of the selling price

The gain percentage

**Formula used :**

Cost price = selling price - gain

gain% = (gain/cost price) × 100

**Solution :**

Let the selling price be x

So, the gain = x/5

The cost price = x - (x/5)

⇒ The cost price = 4x/5 ----(1)

Gain% = [(x/5)/(4x/5)] × 100

⇒ Gain% = 25%

**∴ The gain percentage is 25%**

questions.question: Raju can finish a piece of work in 20 days. He worked at it for 5 days and then Jakob alone finished the remaining work in 15 days. In how many days can both finish it together?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Raju can finish a piece of work in 20 days

Raju worked for 5 days

Jakob finished the remaining work in 15 days

**Concept used :**

The efficiency of work = 1/(number of days to finish work)

**Solution :**

Raju worked for 5 days

So, the remaining work will be finished in 15 days by Raju

Jakob can finish the same piece of work in 20 days

The efficiency of Raju = The efficiency of Jakob

One day work of Raju = 1/20

One day work of Jakob = 1/20

One day work working together = (1/20) + (1/20)

⇒ One day work working together = (1 + 1)/20

⇒ One day work working together = 2/20

⇒ One day work working together = 1/10

**∴ The number of days they both can finish work together is 10 days. **

questions.question: A train, 150 m long, is running at 90 km/h. How long (in seconds) will it take to cross a platform that is 300 m long?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** in m/s = 90 × 5/18 = 25 m/s.

**Total Distance** = Train length + Platform length = 150 + 300 = 450 m.

**Time required** = Total Distance ÷ Speed = 450 ÷ 25 = 18 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 sec.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the **Train** (L₁) = 150 m

Length of the **Platform** (L₂) = 300 m

**Speed** of the train (S) = 90 km/h

**Formula Used:**

1. Speed (m/s) = Speed (km/h) × (5/18)

2. Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

3. Total Distance = Length of Train + Length of Platform

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/303b20fd50ab57502f2e580ca0e9cdc5d08c8519ee53759e8638aea1965d4995.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Converting Speed into m/s:

⇒ Speed = 90 × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Speed = 5 × 5 = 25 m/s

⇒ Total Distance to cross the platform = 150 + 300 = 450 m

⇒ Time taken = 450 ÷ 25

⇒ Time taken = 18 seconds

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 sec.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing Point Objects

When a train crosses a stationary point object like a **pole**, **tree**, or **standing man**, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train itself.

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the **opposite direction**, relative speed is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂). If they move in the **same direction**, it is the difference (S₁ − S₂).</p

questions.question: If a and b are two positive real numbers such that 4a² + b² = 20 and ab = 4, then the value of 2a + b is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Put a = 2, b = 2. This satisfies the given conditions.

Now, 2a + b = 2 × 2 + 2 = 4 + 2 = 6

**Traditional method:**

**Given :**

4a² + b² = 20

ab = 4

**To find :**

2a + b

**Formula used :**

a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab

**Solution :**

4a² + b² = 20

⇒ (2a)² + b² = 20

⇒ (2a + b)² - 2 × 2a × b = 20

⇒ (2a + b)² - 4 × 4 = 20

⇒ (2a + b)² - 16 = 20

⇒ (2a + b)² = 20 + 16

⇒ (2a + b)² = 36

⇒ 2a + b = √36

⇒ 2a + b = 6

**∴ the value of 2a + b is 6.**
